about: Reference names from the Ministry documents: the 7 content areas (sheets) and their 15 elements, and the 12 dimensions of the Digital Competency Framework (2026 update). Used by the teacher layer. The sheets name the elements but do not number them; the codes (1a, 1b...) are ours, in sheet order. 'short' dimension names are the labels on the official Framework poster. Checked against the English and French PDFs on 13 November 2026. Do not reword these; follow the Ministry documents.
